name: Third-Party Risk Management
description: Assess third-party risk through a structured assurance process built on reviewed responses, evidence, and defensible risk visibility.

name: Threats & Protection
description: Interpret governed cybersecurity capability against defined threat scenarios, showing where protection appears stronger, weaker or under-evidenced.

name: Quantitative Risk
description: Turn cyber risk into clearer business and financial insight, from practical bounded analysis to more advanced modelling where needed.

name: Custom Frameworks
description: Operationalise internal methodologies, hybrid models and bespoke requirements through the same governed lifecycle used for recognised frameworks.

name: Controls & Investment
description: Make more informed control decisions by connecting assets, quantified risk, security controls, and cost in one governed view.
